_readme: Mock scenarios for POST /v1/troubleshoot/stream (settings.stream_mock) and for tests. A request matches by normalized query first, then by article title.

scenarios.name: touch_lag
scenarios.description: On-topic pair. Catalog toggles (enable and disable Touch sensitivity), an open-screen link, manual physical steps, critical actions, a backup-before-reset dependency. The headline run.
scenarios.query: My Galaxy S22 screen inputs are delayed and the touch responsiveness is laggy, causing a noticeable delay when I try to interact with the phone.
scenarios.siis_title: Touchscreen issues on a Galaxy phone or tablet

scenarios.name: email_not_responding
scenarios.description: Partly mismatched pair (the article is about email servers, the complaint about a blank screen). Shows all three link tiers, greyed-out irrelevant sections, a lower score, a same-screen merge, and a safe-mode dependency that pushes an action after a critical one.
scenarios.query: My Samsung A115G tablet screen flashes and then goes completely blank whenever I tap to open an email in Gmail, and after it works for a short time it goes blank again.
scenarios.siis_title: Email server not responding on Samsung phone or tablet

scenarios.name: touch_multi_intent
scenarios.description: Authored two-intent complaint against the touch article (the kit has no pair that grounds two goals). Two Goals, duplicate actions removed from the less relevant Goal.
scenarios.query: My Galaxy S22 touch is laggy and my swipes keep getting read as the wrong gesture.
scenarios.siis_title: Touchscreen issues on a Galaxy phone or tablet
